title: Conjugation condition for a normalized quotient section tensor comparison
statement: For every normalized quotient section tensor comparison barB, its SectionTensorNormalized equations imply TensorSectionCondition for the supplied normalized internal tensorator b.

proof.text: Conjugate the supplied internal tensorator through the scalar and tensor comparisons. The normalized computation identifies it on flat-term K-flat generators with the balancing total, and exactness and essential surjectivity extend the equality to all derived pairs.

theorem section_tensor_transport_condition (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ScalarSectionData a T) (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c)
    (b : TensorIso a T) (hb : TensorNormalized a T b)
    (barB : tensor Λ T ⋙ c.model.T ≅
      (c.model.T.prod c.model.T) ⋙ tensor Λ' T)
    (hbarB : SectionTensorNormalized a T c barB) :
    TensorSectionCondition a T c b barB
